item.text: I’m building the 8B dossier around Scholz’s 2022 “Zeitenwende” program, fiscal/energy crisis response, and implementation evidence. Next I’m collecting a small set of primary and high-quality secondary sources that show the program, the machinery used to execute it, and whether outcomes moved in the intended direction.
